It's considered one of Japan's largest events dedicated solely to otaku culture!]

[List of Events at C104 Comic Market 104:

*V-tuber and Normal Cosplay Competition: Attendees are encouraged to showcase their best cosplay talents during this event. Prizes will be awarded based on originality, craftsmanship, and overall presentation.
